_note: Scenario rules are synthetic testing assumptions. They are intended to exercise the PoC pipeline, not to represent verified HVAC fault signatures.

scenarios.name: Low airflow while fan is ON
scenarios.description: Keeps fan ON and drives airflow below its configured normal range.

scenarios.name: Fan OFF / airflow conflict
scenarios.description: Sets fan OFF while airflow remains above the normal operating range.

scenarios.name: Damper stuck
scenarios.description: Holds damper position nearly constant while pressure continues to vary.

scenarios.name: High static pressure
scenarios.description: Drives static pressure above its configured normal range.

scenarios.name: Low airflow + zone temperature drift
scenarios.description: Reduces airflow and gradually shifts zone temperature upward.

scenarios.name: Zone temperature sensor stuck
scenarios.description: Holds zone temperature at a nearly fixed reading.
